subject: Entity verification + wiring details — MSA redline and portal field mapping
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greenarc.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@greenarc.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding: entity docs + wiring info (GreenArc)

Hi Soojin / Karthik —

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We have our procurement team ready to finish the vendor setup in your Ariba/Coupa flows, but they asked for a couple of items before they can complete registration and approve the PO routing:

- Confirmed legal entity name and the final MSA that Redwood wants us to accept (we attached our standard W-9 and a copy of GreenArc's KYC packet).
- Wire instructions for first invoice (we can provide the payer-side template if you need).
- Specific order form field mapping for invoice number / department GL code so our AP team can align their EDI export.

Separately, our legal reviewed the latest MSA you shared and proposed one minor redline around data retention language (they flagged a 7-year archival reference). If you can send the redline back we can route to procurement.

Attached: W-9_GreenArc.pdf (entity docs)

Next steps we propose: you send the MSA with Redwood's preferred wiring template + the Ariba field map we should hit. We can then complete supplier registration and enable PO automation.

Best,
Liam
Head of Procurement
GreenArc Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greenarc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: entity docs + wiring info (GreenArc)

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the note and for sending the W-9. Action items on our side below and who will own them:

- Legal redline review (MSA): Marissa will surface proposed language and confirm acceptable retention window.
- Wiring template: I will attach our standard wiring_instructions_template.xlsx and confirm which fields are required on the first invoice (beneficiary name, account, ACH vs wire).
- Ariba/Coupa field mapping: Karthik, can you produce the minimal mapping (vendor legal name, remit-to address, GL code custom field) that your AP export needs? If Ariba requires additional attributes we can pre-populate.

Marissa — see Liam's note about the 7-year archival. If Legal is okay with a shorter or scoped retention period we can include a parenthetical or exception for operational logs. We want to avoid blocking their procurement flow.

Liam — I'll attach the wiring template and a brief spreadsheet mapping the fields we typically deliver for PO -> invoice automation by EOD. If procurement needs a test PO in staging, we can create one in our sandbox Ariba tenant and share the link.

Thanks,
Soojin
Partner Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: wiring_instructions_template.xlsx (stub)
---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greenarc.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: entity docs + wiring info (GreenArc)

Hi all —

Quick update from Legal after a fast internal loop:

- The 7-year retention callout in GreenArc's note is a concern only if it applies to customer PII or full request logs. We are willing to accept a 3-year general retention window for operational telemetry with an exception for audit evidence tied to invoicing/compliance (retain as long as needed for tax/audit but not an unbounded archival requirement).
- I attached a redlined MSA (Redlined_MSA_v2.docx) that: (a) narrows retention language, (b) adds a standard SOC2 attestation clause we require for any procurement that handles aggregated telemetry, and (c) clarifies that Redwood will fallback to a sanitized export for troubleshooting where appropriate.

Karthik — please confirm the three portal fields we should push to Ariba/Coupa so we can synchronize with GreenArc's AP team:
  1) vendor_legal_name (string)
  2) remit_GL_code (custom numeric string)
  3) remit_method ("wire" | "ACH") and remit_reference (free text up to 30 chars)

Liam / Alex — when you register in our supplier portal we will ask for the W-9 and bank verification (bank letter or voided check). If GreenArc prefers DocuSign for signature on the MSA we can send the DocuSign link once the redline is accepted.

I'll be available this afternoon if you want to hop on a 20-min alignment call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Procurement
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redlined_MSA_v2.docx (tracked changes)
---

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greenarc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: entity docs + wiring info (GreenArc)

Marissa / Soojin —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the redline. We reviewed Redlined_MSA_v2 and the narrower retention language looks reasonable to our InfoSec and Procurement teams. A couple of quick items before we finish registration:

- We will upload bank verification and the W-9 today.
- Can Redwood provide a sandbox PO so we can validate the GL code mapping and our EDI export? If so, please send the test PO number and the Ariba staging link.
- We prefer DocuSign for the MSA (faster for our legal). Please send the DocuSign once you have the final copy.

Thanks — will confirm when uploads are complete.

Best,
Liam
GreenArc Health

Attachment: W-9_GreenArc.pdf (re-sent by GreenArc)
